positive_claim: AM.I18N.1 sealed: Full i18n implementation with pure Rust message catalogs. 24 message keys across 3 languages: English (built-in fallback, build_english_catalog), German (de.json — 24 translated messages), French (fr.json — 24 translated messages). I18nManager honors LC_MESSAGES, LANG, LC_ALL environment variables with C/POSIX fallback to English. MessageCatalog supports get(), get_or_key(), insert(). translate() and translate_fmt() with {arg} substitution. Thread-safe via OnceLock<I18nManager>. 3 unit tests: test_english_catalog, test_translate_fmt, test_init. Wired into diagnostics module via i18n::tr() and i18n::tr_fmt().
non_claims: gettext .po byte-parity — PERMANENT non-claim (NC.PERM.9). We use pure-Rust JSON catalogs, not gettext C FFI.
Message key coverage limited to diagnostics module — not all Automake messages translated

known_divergences.oracle_behavior: GNU automake uses gettext .po files with C FFI
known_divergences.rust_behavior: Pure Rust JSON message catalogs with LC_* env var support
known_divergences.reason: Clean-room safe Rust boundary — no C FFI. PERMANENT design choice.
